title_pt: Marinha do Sri Lanka apreende cerca de 60.448 pepinos-do-mar em Mannar
title_en: Sri Lanka Navy seizes about 60,448 sea cucumbers in Mannar
title_es: La Armada de Sri Lanka decomisa unos 60.448 pepinos de mar en Mannar
card_text_pt: Operação costeira apreendeu aproximadamente 60.448 pepinos-do-mar, 12 botes e 26 suspeitos; a Marinha declarou suspeitar de contrabando para o país.
card_text_en: A coastal operation seized approximately 60,448 sea cucumbers, 12 dinghies and 26 suspects; the Navy stated that the haul was suspected to have been smuggled into the country.
card_text_es: Una operación costera decomisó aproximadamente 60.448 pepinos de mar, 12 botes y detuvo a 26 sospechosos; la Armada indicó sospecha de contrabando hacia el país.
